entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet. Order number is VF98765. Just tell me yes or no.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Pulling up order VF98765 now... I see the VeloFit Aero helmet, delivered 12 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes. The box is unopened. Can I return it?
Understood. Just to be sure, was there a specific issue? For example, was the color not what you expected, or was it a technical concern?
The color is wrong. It doesn't matter why. I just need to know if you'll take it back.

Yes, absolutely. I'm happy to process that return for you right now. Your safety is our top priority, and that means having gear you're confident in. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window.

Of course. I see you're a VIP member with us, so I've also waived the standard return shipping fee. I'm sending that prepaid return label to the email we have on file now. You should see it in the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
